name: dasel-70fd28f3-blind26
instr:
# dasel-regen

We upgraded to a build of this tool cut from the current tree, and a large amount of routine work now comes back wrong or fails outright. The repository has received 26 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the documents we hand it changed and nothing about the way we invoke it changed; what follows is what we managed to reproduce by hand, described by what we were trying to do at the time.

Narrowing a document down to the part we want is where we noticed it first. Keeping only the items of a list that satisfy a condition is broken however the condition is written — against a number, against the name an item sits under, or a condition that is simply always true — and so is such a narrowing chained ahead of a check that every survivor holds; the published example that narrows people by age and returns their names no longer gives its two names. Putting a list in order is broken twice over and both want repairing: merely accepting a request to arrange a list by one of its fields, with or without a direction word, already goes wrong before anything is evaluated, and separately, actually carrying out an ascending or descending arrangement over whole numbers, fractional numbers or words fails even once the request has been understood.
